authorization.request: 用户要求插件商城可搜索 build-dsh-plugin，补齐 Web/Desktop 商城样式与缺失功能；已要求详情、筛选及安装/启动/关闭/卸载入口，并明确已审核插件由 DSH Desktop 官方管理器按自身规则校验。

objective: 发布 DSH Store 0.9.22 Desktop marketplace UI 修复：受限记录可发现和查看，恢复完整目录浏览与已安装管理视图，保留 Catalog 审核边界并让官方 DSH Desktop 管理器决定已审核插件的运行兼容性。

change.directory: Catalog approved 和 blocked 条目可搜索；unlisted 仍隐藏。搜索覆盖标识、名称、用途、权限、固定来源、分类与审核原因。
change.views: 新增插件目录和已安装分页，支持分类、Catalog 状态、Desktop 适配标识筛选、排序、清除筛选、计数与分页；目录外已安装插件以只读状态显示。
change.lifecycle: 列表卡片和详情均提供适用的安装、启动、关闭、卸载动作；已审核第三方条目的兼容检查由 DSH Desktop 官方 pluginManager 决定，Catalog blocked 条目不开放安装或启动。
change.presentation: 使用 DSH 样式令牌、响应式卡片、状态徽标和独立视图导航；页面标题为插件商城（DSH-Store），设置侧栏名为插件商城。

gates: Bind every changed file to the full main Commit and exact base/postcondition hashes; reject any out-of-scope change.

Disposable Desktop fixtures prove blocked build-dsh-plugin can be found and inspected while install stays disabled; approved entries without a Desktop declaration remain available to the official manager.

Disposable Desktop fixtures cover catalog and installed tabs, search of a directory-only bundle, adaptation filters, visible lifecycle actions, and the lack of Store controls for unlisted installed bundles.
Do not change a real DSH Profile or package as part of the source PR. Real Desktop installation and UI acceptance remain separate planned operations.
Publish through an exact-head CI-checked source PR, then pin the merged full Commit using a fresh Catalog plan and independently verify GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn.

rollback.source: Revert only this exact UI release through a CI-checked PR.
rollback.desktopProfile: This source change does not update any real DSH Profile or package. Any later local update uses the DSH official Plugin Manager under a separate explicit plan.

healthCheck: node --test test/desktop-compat.test.mjs verifies the searchable blocked record, view controls, category/status/adaptation filtering, details and lifecycle visibility with disposable manager fixtures; the full repository check and exact-head CI are separate release gates.
